summary: Development shells use client-side-capable sccache 0.19.0 and preserve inherited compiler wrappers and cache settings

replay.detail: Development environment only; no runtime replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No user-visible runtime, client protocol, pairing, or rolling-upgrade contract changes. The development compiler-cache client supports client-side compilation and inherits host cache routing.

downtime.detail: No running service is restarted or reconfigured.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no upgrade steps. Developers receive the updated compiler-cache default on entering the Nix development shell; inherited wrappers, including an empty opt-out, remain unchanged.

recovery.detail: No runtime state or recovery procedure changes.
